command: python -m src.baselines --config config/config_incyde.yaml --manifest data/incyde/manifest.csv --out results/incyde_baselines --workers 4 --feature-cache data/incyde/feature_table.csv --manifest-command 'python -m src.incyde --root /tmp/incyde/unpacked --out data/incyde/manifest.csv --zip /tmp/incyde/Cropped_cyclone_data.zip'
comparability: INSAT-3D/3DR only. Not comparable with NASA or TCIR tables. Not like-for-like with Agrawal et al. 2024. All metrics use raw 3-minute IMD labels. wind_averaging is 3-min and wind_averaging_s is 180 on every row. There is no 1-minute conversion.
metrics_use: All metrics use raw 3-minute IMD labels. wind_averaging is 3-min and wind_averaging_s is 180 on every row. There is no 1-minute conversion.
on_fix_definition: on_fix is true when the filename clock is IST, minus 05:30, and the UTC time is exactly 00/03/06/09/12/15/18/21:00, and the frame is not flagged outside_imd_track_span. This is the IMD 3-hourly synoptic cadence, not a workbook join.
